summary.body:
Resolved on master by #548 (merge `2416c37`), completing the remaining work after #525.

Related fixes:

- #525 corrected enclosing-delimiter/call-group handling and binding-frame safety for the original crash and dropped callbacks.
- #531, #533 and #534 corrected arrow object bodies, line boundaries and ternary boundaries; #536 preserved callback parameters; #545 corrected template condition metrics.
- #548 restores runtime labeled blocks and separates type annotations from runtime syntax. Typed fields/assertions retain real functions without phantoms; contextual `as`/`satisfies` calls and runtime operators retain callbacks while nested generic, import/query and template types keep their own delimiters.

Verification: all original six reproducers and eleven authored #525 examples remain covered across the seven JS-family suffixes, including NS/nonstrict, CSV/`-o` and HTTP consumers. Full pytest and `make` pass: **2,917 passed, 7 existing skips**, with 490 added regression cases. All applicable exact-head hosted checks passed. All 18 performance comparisons pass; the worst paired 95% upper slowdown is **2.7992%**, below 3%.

After merge, master’s runtime/test trees and its complete 638-source default/NS observations plus broad CLI output match the qualified head. All reported and confirmed remaining cases are resolved on master.

Thank you for the detailed report, reproducers and related contributions!
